title: Decoding the fixed action bits
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $a$ be a one-work-tape action with Boolean symbols and states in $\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$. Its eight fixed action bits decode to its input-head movement, work-tape write instruction, work-head movement, and optional output symbol, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an action with one work tape, Boolean symbols, and state set $\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$
replaced:
Decoding the four fixed two-bit pairs of a transition action's eight-bit
serialization recovers, in order, the action's input-head movement, its
optional work-tape write, its work-head movement, and its optional emission.
